title: City delight
text: Federico was very knowledgeable about Barcelona.  He was friendly and patient with our tour. He made sure we saw the key points but also let us set our own pace.
author: DillardKeith_H

title: Bacelona walking too
text:
Our guide Pau was passionate about Barcelona and sports.  He goes like the energizer bunny.  This was a great way to explore the city and see the inside of his experiences.  He picked a fantastic place for lunch with fresh seafood and paella.  And, he seems to be a very avid history buff.  He takes you back 3,000 years and brings you right to today with the politics and happening in the city.
I would be remiss to not to point out that this was a walking tour in the hottest season on record.  As a result, we did take a few cabs to get between places (which was very welcome with some air conditi
author: Ted_C

title: Couldn’t have been better
text: Fantastic! Alan took us to places no other tourists could see. And the lunch experience was wonderful.
author: Janet_B

title: Great option for first time trip to Barcelona
text: This was my first time in Barcelona and having a full-day private tour guide was a very good choice. She met me at my hotel and showed me all around the area. The experience was very personalized.
author: Mo_J

title: Getting to know Barcelona
text: Pao was great.  He shared his knowledge about Barcelona with emphasis on sports, which is his passion.  We took taxis to many of the venues to reduce the time between sites and allow more time at each site.  Pao took us to a great local restaurant away from the tourist spots.  This was fully customizable.
author: Robert_S

title: Barca on foot
text: Pau was very friendly and knowledgeable. The city is amazing to see on foot, and having a local guide allows you to see things you would miss otherwise. Thanks Pau!
author: Leigh_F

title: Walking highlights Barcelona
text: What a great way to experience Barcelona - truly the highlights !  The guide was fantastic, knowledgeable, astute, charming and full of stories.  While it didn’t include entrance to any of the Gaudi sites - you could fully customize the experience with the exception being that many entrances require advance booking during the holidays - this was a ‘highly recommended’ experience!
author: heidi_l

title: Barcelona for a day with Claire
text: We were greeted by our tour guide Claire via email well in advance of our trip to plan our tour.  She selected sites she thought we'd be interested in seeing and confirmed her plans with us in advance.  On the day of the tour she arrived early and was a joy to be around for a full day in Barcelona.  She showed us sites of interest at an enjoyable pace and selected stops for a coffee break and lunch that were both excellent.  If you have a chance for a day in Barcelona with Claire, our group of four gives her our highest recommendations.
author: j7040club

title: A fabulous day with Simone in Barcelona
text: Simone was a fatastic host, and planned the day completely around us, adapting it as we went along depending on our needs, and the changes in the weather!  She was full of enthumsiasm for this fantastic city and we packed a huge amount into a day without at any point feeling rushed.
author: Exploration18951

title: Few days in Barcelona
text: Karla was excellent! This was my first time in Barcelona and we managed to cover a lot in one day. She was friendly, helpful and knowledgeable and made me feel welcomed. I will definitely recommend Karla and City Unscripted to whoever wants a personalized experience in Barcelona.
author: Malena A
